extraction_note: Straight sink bases from printed p.44 only. Printed p.45 (fixed front + jumbo drawer, suffixes 90/91) and printed p.46 (corner sink bases, AU/AW/A81171) are NOT extracted yet - p.45 carries an unresolved 90-vs-91 question and p.46 needs corner placement (M2.2).

sink_base_door.description: Sink base unit with door - 1 rh or lh door, 1 aluminium tray
sink_base_door.notes: No d.35 sink base is listed on the page; the explicit rows are the authority. The aluminium tray is stated by the source but is interior - recorded, not drawn.

front_layout.note: One door covering the full front, as for the plain base unit.

sink_base_door.wall_hung_note: SWEPT 2026-08-24 (printed p.19 pictogram sweep), printed p.44. The 'Hung version' glyph is printed beside d.62 and d.67 and the margin carries 'Surch. for wall-hung version on page 548'. No flame on either band.

sink_base_doors.description: Sink base unit with doors - 2 doors, 1 aluminium tray

front_layout.note: Two doors; the page drawing shows an equal split. Equal widths are a representation assumption consistent with the drawing, not a stated dimension.

sink_base_doors.wall_hung_note: SWEPT 2026-08-24 (printed p.19 pictogram sweep), printed p.44. The 'Hung version' glyph is printed beside d.62 and d.67 and the margin carries 'Surch. for wall-hung version on page 548'. No flame on either band.

interior_confirmed: 1 jumbo drawer with shaped back panel
sink_base_jumbo_drawer.notes: Source states no Push-pull device. Servo Drive referenced on the page as an option (p.567). W600 only.

front_layout.note: Elevation printed p.44: 78 / 75, i.e. one full-height front (handle 780; gola 750).

sink_base_jumbo_drawer.wall_hung_note: SWEPT 2026-08-24 (printed p.19 pictogram sweep), printed p.44. The 'Hung version' glyph is printed beside d.62 and d.67 and the margin carries 'Surch. for wall-hung version on page 548'. No flame on either band.

sink_base_jumbo_drawers.description: Sink base unit with jumbo drawers - 1 top jumbo drawer with shaped interior for sink, 1 jumbo drawer with shaped back panel, 1 aluminium tray
interior_confirmed: 1 top jumbo drawer with shaped interior for sink
1 jumbo drawer with shaped back panel
sink_base_jumbo_drawers.notes: Servo Drive referenced on the page as an option (p.567). The top drawer's shaped interior clears the sink bowl - stated by the source, interior, not drawn. No W600 row on the page; smallest is W750.

front_layout.note: Elevation printed p.44: 39 / 39 (handle); gola shows 36 / 36. Same split as the plain jumbo-drawers unit on printed p.40.
front_layout.gola_note: Both jumbo fronts lose 30 (390->360); undercounter recess above the top front, intermediate recess between the two. A gola unit therefore needs BOTH profiles, same system.

sink_base_jumbo_drawers.wall_hung_note: SWEPT 2026-08-24 (printed p.19 pictogram sweep), printed p.44. The 'Hung version' glyph is printed beside d.62 and d.67 and the margin carries 'Surch. for wall-hung version on page 548'. No flame on either band.

page_observations: NO HOB GLYPH ANYWHERE ON printed p.44, at either depth, in any of the four positions - swept 2026-08-24 against printed p.19's legend. The H.58.5 sink page says the same thing, so two sink sections now agree that a sink base is not offered hob provisions, and neither derives it.

EVERY POSITION CARRIES THE HUNG GLYPH at both depths, plus the margin surcharge. Recorded on each type as wall_hung true rather than left absent, because an absent key is exactly what the sweep existed to abolish.
